messages:
Maria Chen: Hey finance — EmberTech submitted invoice INV-2026-432 but AP says no PO matched. Vendor also attached credit note CN-123. Can someone help confirm PO routing? Invoice net $4,800, credit $1,200, PO 98765 shows committed $6,000. Invoice is due tomorrow.

AccountsPayableBot: New invoice uploaded: INV-2026-432 (EmberTech). Status: pending PO match.

Kevin O'Leary: @Maria can you attach the vendor PDF and the PO snapshot? also need vendor id.

Maria Chen: Attached: https://files.internal/embertech/INV-2026-432.pdf and https://files.internal/embertech/CN-123.pdf

Ashley Patel: Checked procurement — PO `98765` exists but was amended to `98765-REV2`. Approver was changed to Jordan Wu, but looks like routing to finance failed after the amend. :confused:

Jordan Wu: I didn't get an approval ping. I can approve once AP confirms amounts reconcile.

Kevin O'Leary: Hold payment. AP don't pay until we confirm credit note application. What's GL and cost center?

Maria Chen: GL 5201, cost center ENG-INFRA. Vendor says credit is for prior month overbilling.

Samir Gupta: Legal — please forward the vendor email thread and any contract clause re: credits. If this was an overbilling, we'll need vendor to sign off on credit application.

Ashley Patel: Sending vendor thread now. FYI vendor contact: maria@embertech.com, acct-pay@embertech.com

Kevin O'Leary: I'll update accounting ticket with hold and assign to Jordan for approval. Ticket: ACCT-4523

Maria Chen: Thanks. If Jordan approves we can net the credit against this invoice and schedule payment next run. :thumbsup: 

Jordan Wu: I'll review and approve if numbers match. Ping me when AP updates the PO in the system. :eyes: 

AccountsPayableBot: Invoice INV-2026-432 status updated to 'on hold' by Kevin O'Leary.

Samir Gupta: Noted. I'll review vendor emails and reply with legal signoff or request. Expect update EOD.

Kevin O'Leary: Great — @Maria and @Ashley please reply here if anything changes.
